title: $τ$-Rec-Books: A Disclosure-Controlled Benchmark for Requirement Elicitation in Agentic Recommender Systems
title_zh: τ-Rec-Books：面向智能体推荐系统需求获取的披露受控基准

paragraphs.en: 提出τ-Rec-Books基准评估推荐智能体需求获取能力，成功率随需求披露程度递减，hidden任务平均仅0.283。 While conversational recommendation systems provide a more natural user interface, they face the challenge of progressively discovering a user's needs before they can recommend an item that satisfies them. To evaluate the ability of AI agents at this elicitation process, we introduce $τ$-Rec-Books, a benchmark that holds each user request fixed while varying only when the user reveals their requirements: all at the start (volunteer), one at the start and the rest when asked (mixed), or some never (hidden). A hidden requirement can be found only by proposing books and inferring it from the user's accept or reject verdicts. We generate 450 tasks over a catalog of 20,000 books from Wikidata, develop a rule-based simulated user to answer the agent, and score recommendations against catalog metadata without an LLM judge. Across four agents and two search interfaces, success rates fall for every agent and interface, on average from 0.975 (volunteer) to 0.756 (mixed) and 0.283 (hidden). Mixed tasks fail mainly because agents do not ask, and when told to ask, every agent reaches at least 0.931. On hidden tasks, most failures come from agents recommending a book they never proposed to the user. When told to propose first, agents only match a simple baseline that proposes popular books, and stay well below one that uses rejection to rule out possible requirements. We release the catalog pipeline, task generator, simulated user, validators, reference agents, and all agent traces at https://github.com/nbharaths/tau-rec/tree/main/data/tracks/books-wikidata-v2.
paragraphs.zh: 提出τ-Rec-Books基准以评估推荐智能体的需求获取能力，成功率随需求披露程度递减，hidden任务平均仅0.283。虽然对话式推荐系统提供了更自然的用户界面，但它们面临一个挑战：在推荐出满足用户需求的物品之前，需要逐步发现用户的需求。 为了评估AI智能体在这一需求获取过程中的能力，我们提出了$τ$-Rec-Books基准，该基准保持每个用户请求不变，仅改变用户揭示需求的时间：全部在一开始就主动说出（volunteer）、一个在开始说出而其余在被问到时说出（mixed）、或有些始终不说出（hidden）。 隐藏的需求只能通过推荐书籍并从用户的接受或拒绝判断中推断出来才能发现。 我们基于来自Wikidata的20,000本图书目录生成了450个任务，开发了一个基于规则的模拟用户来回答智能体，并对照目录元数据对推荐进行评分，无需LLM裁判。 在四个智能体和两种搜索界面上，每个智能体和界面的成功率都在下降，平均从0.975（volunteer）降至0.756（mixed）和0.283（hidden）。 mixed任务的失败主要因为智能体不主动询问，而在被要求询问时，每个智能体的成功率都至少达到0.931。 在hidden任务上，大多数失败源于智能体推荐了一本从未向用户提出过的书。 当被告知先提出推荐时，智能体仅能达到一个推荐热门书籍的简单基线水平，并且远低于利用拒绝来排除可能需求的基线。 我们在 https://github.com/nbharaths/tau-rec/tree/main/data/tracks/books-wikidata-v2 上发布了目录构建流水线、任务生成器、模拟用户、验证器、参考智能体以及所有智能体轨迹。
